turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to update my CRM with some new contacts. Can you help me find James Le's old LinkedIn URL? I think it was linkedin.com/in/jle-dev/.
Noted. I've saved that James Le's LinkedIn profile is linkedin.com/in/jle-dev/. Is there anything else you need for the CRM update?
No, that's it. Oh, by the way, do you have a recipe for a quick pasta dish? I'm out of ideas.
Sure! How about Aglio e Olio? It's simple garlic and oil pasta with chili flakes. Just sauté minced garlic in olive oil, add red pepper flakes, toss with cooked spaghetti, and finish with parsley.
Sounds good. I might try that tonight. Thanks.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need anything else.
Lloyd, quick update. James Le changed his LinkedIn handle recently. It's not the old one anymore.
Understood. What is the new URL?
It's linkedin.com/in/khanhnamle94/. Please remember that for future reference.
Got it. I've updated my records to reflect James Le's new profile URL.
Great. Also, did my package from Amazon arrive yet? The tracking said Tuesday.
I don't have access to your physical mail or delivery status in real-time, but I can check if you provide the tracking number.
Ah, right. I'll check the app myself. Thanks.
